name: Credential Attack Response Playbook
description: Respond to brute-force, password-spraying or repeated login-failure activity.

steps.name: Block attacking sources
steps.description: Add the attacking IPs to the platform blocklist.

steps.name: Snapshot evidence
steps.description: Preserve the authentication events and indicators.

steps.name: Review targeted accounts
steps.description: Check whether any attempt succeeded; force password reset and revoke sessions for affected accounts.

steps.name: Enforce MFA and lockout policy
steps.description: Ensure MFA and rate limiting protect the exposed service.

steps.name: Notify service owner
steps.description: Inform the asset owner and security team.
